label: The range-limit update
subgoals: Compute 1 minus 0.44 plus the acceptance rate
Multiply the old range limit by that factor
Clamp the result between 1 and the grid dimension

label: Successive updates
subgoals: Apply the first update with its acceptance rate
Apply the second update to the clamped result
Keep the clamping bounds at every step

label: Counting candidate targets
subgoals: Floor the range limit to an integer r
Clip the window x minus r to x plus r and y likewise to the grid
Multiply the window's columns by rows and subtract the block's own site
